note: Corps campground below Pomme de Terre Dam: one row of back-in sites between the camp road and the Pomme de Terre River, the water a few steps from the pads under scattered bank trees. The river rises and falls quickly with dam releases. Trailhead for a 3-mile riverside trail. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on rec.gov: 19 sites, all 50A + water, up to 40 ft; peak $26; reservation-only, 14-night limit; reservable Apr 16-Sep 30 with an announced limited off-season. The water is the outlet river, ~35 m wide, 15-25 m from every pad: riverfront upgrade candidate. Small pin move. Phone to add.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored riverview) - UPGRADE CANDIDATE to riverfront, owner's call: the water is the Pomme de Terre River below the dam (the outlet channel), not the lake; the dam is ~1.3 km upstream and out of the picture, so the below-the-dam rule (no lake value) is met by the stored river class. On the 0.29 m/px leaf-off frames the channel beside the sites measures ~35-38 m bank to bank (river class). All 19 pads are on the river side of the single camp road, back-in toward the water, their heads 15-25 m from the bank; between pad and water there is mown ground with a line of scattered large bank trees (sycamores, crowns not touching), no road and no closed timber belt. Against: bank height is not known (the notice 'Water levels on the river can rise or fall very quickly' implies a low bank), rec.gov gives no 'Proximity to Water' attribute, and site photos were not viewed. The view itself is confirmed: riverview is the floor.

PIN MOVE (small, ~130 m): stored 37.9046,-93.3275 falls south of the camp road at the edge of an open field; the site row runs from 37.90482,-93.32562 (site 010) to 37.90566,-93.33233 (site 028). Proposed 37.90540,-93.32890, the middle of the row. (The rec.gov facility point, 37.90278,-93.32917, is 300 m south in woods.)

SEASON: the notice announces the limited off-season (Mar 15-Apr 15, Oct 1-Nov 30) but the calendar sold no October-November 2026 nights and none before Apr 16 2027; with 'no first-come-first-serve window' it is not clear how an off-season night is obtained. Written the same way as 1878 Nemo Landing on the same lake: season Mar 15-Nov 30, booking season Apr 16-Sep 30, the gap stated in booking.note. A call to 417-745-2290 would settle it.
FEES: off-season price disagrees between the notice ($10) and the 2027 rate table ($16); nightly_low left at the stored 16, both figures in fees.note.
Calendar closure Apr 26-May 2 2027 on all sites (reason not stated on rec.gov).
